name: Story Circle
description: Dan Harmon's eight-step story circle in three acts: the character wants something, goes into an unfamiliar situation, adapts and takes the prize, then returns changed.

children.title: You
children.synopsis: A character is in a zone of comfort.

scenes.title: The Familiar
scenes.synopsis: Establish a living, breathing ordinary state.

children.title: Need
children.synopsis: But they want something they don't yet know they need.

scenes.title: The Want
scenes.synopsis: Name the gap between comfort and desire.

children.title: Go
children.synopsis: They enter an unfamiliar situation, crossing a threshold.

scenes.title: The Crossing
scenes.synopsis: The character leaves comfort for the unknown.

children.title: Search
children.synopsis: They adapt to the new situation and stumble toward a goal.

scenes.title: Adaptation
scenes.synopsis: Trial and error explores the new world.

children.title: Find
children.synopsis: They find what they've been looking for, superficially.

scenes.title: The Discovery
scenes.synopsis: The surface want comes within reach.

children.title: Take
children.synopsis: They take it, but paying a cost or being changed by the price.

scenes.title: The Price
scenes.synopsis: The gain costs something the character must surrender.

children.title: Return
children.synopsis: They return to the familiar with hard-won change.

scenes.title: Homeward
scenes.synopsis: The changed character re-enters the starting world.

children.title: Change
children.synopsis: Having changed, the circle completes and the story lands.

scenes.title: The Last Beat
scenes.synopsis: Show the transformation by contrast, not by telling.
